tasks.name: Floor protection setup
tasks.notes: Drop cloth under closet opening. Always required — RP always has finished floors. ~2-3 min per closet.

tasks.name: Visual condition assessment
tasks.description: Brief visual condition scan of all shelf surfaces per closet. Check for peeling, mildew, water stains, general paint condition. Assign substrate state. Verify closet contents removed by homeowner.
tasks.notes: Single combined assessment task — no separate adhesion/coating-ID/moisture subtasks needed for closet shelving. ~3-5 min per closet. FIXED time. Contents removal is homeowner responsibility — painter verifies cleared.

tasks.name: Degloss / scuff sand existing paint
tasks.description: Scuff sand existing paint with 150 grit for adhesion profile. Light scuff for flat/eggshell existing finish; more thorough for satin. Mechanical scuff is standard for closet shelving — chemical degloss rarely used.
tasks.notes: Always required for RP. Rate varies slightly by existing sheen but modeled as single binary task. Absorbs NC TSK_DUST_WIPE and TSK_LIGHT_SAND into single RP action.

tasks.name: Scrape and feather failing paint
tasks.description: Scrape loose/failing paint, feather edges smooth with 120 grit. Remove all loose material before priming.
tasks.notes: Conditional — only for failing or peeling states. Per-opening rate. Feather edges to avoid visible step at paint film boundary.

tasks.name: Mildew biocide treatment
tasks.description: Apply biocide solution (bleach 1:3 or commercial mildewcide) to all mildew-affected shelf surfaces. Scrub with stiff brush, rinse, allow 24 hr dry before priming.
tasks.notes: Per-closet task — all affected surfaces in one closet treated together. Most common RP-specific task for closet shelving. 24 hr dry time before next step — may require return visit.

tasks.name: Spot fill defects
tasks.description: Fill nail holes, minor surface defects with lightweight spackle. Sand smooth when dry.

quality_notes.QT2: Fill only visible holes and deep defects.
quality_notes.QT3: Fill all nail holes, dents, and surface imperfections.

tasks.notes: Direct transfer from NC. Same action in RP — fill defects on existing surfaces. QT-scaled: QT2 minimal, QT3 thorough.

tasks.name: Caulk repair (failed sections)
tasks.description: Assess existing caulk at shelf-to-wall gaps and joints. Remove and replace failed sections only (15-30% typical). Not full re-caulk like NC.
tasks.notes: Modified from NC TSK_CAULK. RP only replaces failed caulk sections — faster than full NC caulking. Per-opening rate is lower than NC caulk rate.

tasks.name: Prime - adhesion primer (brush/roll)
tasks.description: Apply adhesion primer by brush/roll on scraped/failing areas or full surface if extensive. Water-based adhesion promoter for previously painted surfaces.
tasks.notes: State-driven primer. Spot prime scraped areas for SS_INT_FAILING_PAINT. Full prime for SS_INT_PEELING. No primer needed for SS_INT_SOUND_PAINT.

tasks.name: Prime - stain-block primer (brush/roll)
tasks.description: Apply acrylic stain-blocking primer by brush/roll on contaminated surfaces. Seals water stains, mildew residue, smoke/nicotine deposits.
tasks.notes: State-driven primer. Full surface prime for both moisture and smoke damage states. Acrylic stain-blocker (not shellac) is sufficient for closet shelving.

tasks.name: Prime - general brush/roll primer
tasks.description: General purpose acrylic primer by brush/roll. Used when substrate state warrants primer but not a specialty product (e.g., when adhesion primer spot-applied leaves gaps that need full prime).
tasks.state_condition_note: Conditional on substrate_state — no primer for SS_INT_SOUND_PAINT (most common). Used as fallback when adhesion or stain-block primer does not cover full scope.
tasks.notes: Modified from NC TSK_PRIME_BRUSH_ROLL. RP context: state-driven primer selection rather than bare-substrate primer. This task is the catch-all for cases where primer is needed but specialty primers are not indicated.

tasks.name: Finish coat - brush and roll
tasks.description: Apply finish coat(s) by brush and roll. QT2=1 coat, QT3=2 coats. Standard acrylic enamel on closet shelf surfaces.

quality_notes.QT2: 1 coat. Check for holidays and drips. Minimal touch-up.
quality_notes.QT3: 2 coats. Even coverage, no drips, clean edges. Allow dry time between coats per manufacturer.

tasks.notes: Direct transfer from NC TSK_FINISH_BRUSH_ROLL. Same rates, same technique. Coat count driven by QT. No interstage sanding between coats — closet shelving at QT2/QT3 does not warrant it.

tasks.name: Floor protection teardown
tasks.notes: Remove floor protection. Direct transfer from NC. ~1-2 min per closet.

tasks.name: Final inspection and touch-up
tasks.description: Inspect per QT inspection distance. Touch-up any holidays, drips, or missed spots.

quality_notes.QT2: Glance check — no drips, no misses, full coverage.
quality_notes.QT3: Quick visual at arm's length. No drips, even coverage, clean edges.

tasks.notes: Direct transfer from NC. Per-opening rate. QT-scaled: QT2 quick glance, QT3 thorough arm's-length check.

tasks.name: Customer walkthrough
tasks.description: Brief post-completion walkthrough with homeowner per closet. Verify shelves are coated, no drips on floor/walls, closet ready for contents replacement.
tasks.notes: RP-new task. ~1-2 min per closet. Minimal compared to door/room walkthrough. Per-closet (EA_CLOSET), not per-opening.

round_configurations.name: QT2 Economy: 1 Finish Coat (No Prime)
round_configurations.description: Single finish coat. QT2 economy on sound existing paint.
round_configurations.notes: Simplest round. Sound paint, degloss, 1 finish coat. Most common QT2 scenario.

round_configurations.name: QT2 Economy: Prime + 1 Finish Coat
round_configurations.description: State-driven prime + single finish coat. QT2 economy with primer needed.
round_configurations.notes: QT2 with substrate issues. Primer type selected by substrate state.

round_configurations.name: QT3 Standard: 2 Finish Coats (No Prime)
round_configurations.description: Two finish coats. QT3 standard on sound existing paint.
round_configurations.notes: Standard RP round for sound paint. No primer, 2 finish coats.

round_configurations.name: QT3 Standard: Prime + 2 Finish Coats
round_configurations.description: State-driven prime + two finish coats. QT3 standard with primer needed.
round_configurations.notes: Full QT3 treatment with substrate remediation. Most common round for closets with condition issues.
